Alford is entering his eighth season at Nevada, where his teams have gone 137-88 with NCAA Tournament appearances in 2023 and 2024. He is 724-386 overall.

“After 36 years, I feel like this is the right time to step away from the bench,” Alford said in a statement Thursday. “Tanya and I have loved our time in Reno and have embraced this amazing community and built lifelong friendships.
